name: extensions-gallery
title: Extensions Gallery
description: Browse and launch the Raycast extensions of your CustomExtensions monorepo
author: CaffeineCat

commands.name: view-gallery
commands.title: View Gallery
commands.description: Browse and launch your custom extensions

preferences.name: packagesPath
preferences.title: Packages Directory
preferences.description: Path to the packages directory of the CustomExtensions monorepo. Leave empty to auto-detect.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
